benchmarks.title: Benchmarks explained
benchmarks.intro: Every AI test in plain language — what it measures, how to read the score, and where it can fool you. No jargon.
benchmarks.whatAreBody: A benchmark is a standardized exam for AI models. Everyone takes the same test, so the scores can be compared. Some tests are multiple-choice quizzes, some make the model write real code, and some let real people vote on which answer they prefer.
benchmarks.whyMisleadBody: A high score is not a guarantee. Tests get 'saturated' (everyone aces them), can leak into training data, or measure something narrow that has little to do with your actual job. That is why botbrix shows several benchmarks per skill and never relies on a single number.
benchmarks.howWeUseBody: Where measured data exists, we normalize each test to a 0–100 scale and feed the intelligence/reasoning/coding/math tests into the quality part of our score. The written explanation is separate from the number. Until a benchmark is measured for a model, we show 'not yet measured' instead of a made-up value.

methodology.title: Methodology & transparency
methodology.intro: How botbrix collects data, calculates scores, and where the limits are.
methodology.scoringBody: Every numeric score is produced by deterministic, rule-based formulas over structured signals (context window, capabilities, price, provider coverage, recency). Large language models may write the human-readable explanations, but they never set the numbers.
methodology.benchmarksBody: Benchmarks are imperfect and do not always predict real-world performance. Dedicated benchmark importers (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, SWE-bench, LMArena, Artificial Analysis, and more) are on the roadmap. Until a benchmark is ingested for a model, its quality component is a transparent structural proxy and is marked as estimated.
methodology.sourcesBody: Data is gathered from provider APIs, marketplaces (OpenRouter), benchmark sources and public documentation. We try to be as accurate as possible but cannot guarantee perfect correctness.
methodology.sponsoredBody: Sponsored or featured placements are always clearly marked and never affect organic scores or rankings.
methodology.estimatedBody: Some descriptions may be AI-generated and reviewed over time. Estimated values are flagged. We never present fabricated data as measured.

footer.disclaimer: Data is gathered from APIs, public sources and benchmarks and enriched automatically. It may be incomplete or outdated. Not financial or professional advice.
